I’ll trace scorer reconstruction and guardrail loading, then add the server restriction and focused tests. I’ll use the repository’s Python style skill for these changes.

The code already checks whether custom scorers are enabled, but that still permits reconstruction inside the server. I’ll add an inert scorer at the reconstruction boundary and grant execution permission only in job worker entry points. Guardrails will reject custom scorers before deserialization, including those nested in ensembles.

The restriction and guardrail checks are in place. I’m adding tests for source-code side effects, metadata preservation, executor and client behavior, and nested custom guardrails. The existing guardrail loading tests passed; three tracing tests failed because they found no recorded traces.

All 88 focused tests passed, including the new security tests and guardrail creation tests with workspaces enabled and disabled. Pytest’s final process-reporting hook then hit a sandbox restriction. I’m rerunning with that summary disabled and including the existing client-loading tests.

Implemented inert custom scorers in the server, preserving metadata and serialization while rejecting execution. Job executors retain execution permission through process-local state; client behavior stays unchanged.

Guardrails now reject custom scorers, including nested ensembles. Existing custom guardrails fail requests with HTTP 500 naming the guardrail; other loading failures remain logged and skipped.

Validation: 91 focused tests passed, followed by 8 passing scorer tests after final adjustments. Three tracing tests in an earlier broader run failed with no recorded traces. No dependencies installed.

+import json
+from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+from mlflow.exceptions import MlflowException
+from mlflow.genai.scorers.scorer_utils import _obj_has_call_source
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from mlflow.genai.scorers.base import SerializedScorer
+
+
+class CustomScorerGuardrailError(MlflowException):
+    def __init__(self, name: str):
+        super().__init__(
+            f"Guardrail '{name}' contains custom scorer code. Gateway guardrails must use "
+            "built-in scorers or make_judge() judges instead."
+        )
+
+
+def validate_guardrail_scorer(
+    serialized_scorer: "str | dict | SerializedScorer", name: str
+) -> None:
+    if isinstance(serialized_scorer, str):
+        serialized_scorer = json.loads(serialized_scorer)
+    elif is_dataclass(serialized_scorer):
+        serialized_scorer = asdict(serialized_scorer)
+    if _obj_has_call_source(serialized_scorer):
+        raise CustomScorerGuardrailError(name)

+import os
+import sys
+
+from mlflow.store.artifact.host_policy import is_tracking_server_process
+
+# Set only by job worker entry points, never from inherited environment variables.
+_executor_pid: int | None = None
+
+
+def mark_scorer_executor_process() -> None:
+    global _executor_pid
+    _executor_pid = os.getpid()
+
+
+def is_scorer_execution_forbidden() -> bool:
+    if _executor_pid == os.getpid():
+        return False
+    server = sys.modules.get("mlflow.server")
+    return is_tracking_server_process() or bool(getattr(server, "is_running_as_server", False))

+from dataclasses import asdict
+
+import pytest
+
+from mlflow.exceptions import MlflowException
+from mlflow.genai.judges import make_judge
+from mlflow.genai.scorers import Safety, Scorer
+from mlflow.genai.scorers.base import ScorerKind, SerializedScorer
+from mlflow.utils import scorer_execution
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("enabled", ["true", "false"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tracking_uri", ["databricks", "sqlite://"])
+def test_server_loads_custom_scorer_without_executing_code(monkeypatch, enabled, tracking_uri):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("_MLFLOW_SERVER_ARTIFACT_ROOT", "mlflow-artifacts:/")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS", enabled)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI", tracking_uri)
+    serialized = SerializedScorer(
+        name="custom",
+        description="description",
+        aggregations=["mean"],
+        timeout=12,
+        is_session_level_scorer=True,
+        call_source="return True",
+        call_signature="(inputs=1 / 0)",
+        original_func_name="custom",
+    )
+    loaded = Scorer.model_validate(serialized)
+    assert loaded.model_dump() == asdict(serialized)
+    assert loaded.name == "custom"
+    assert loaded.description == "description"
+    assert loaded.aggregations == ["mean"]
+    assert loaded.timeout == 12
+    assert loaded.is_session_level_scorer
+    assert loaded.kind == ScorerKind.DECORATOR
+    assert Scorer.model_validate_json(loaded.model_dump_json()).model_dump() == asdict(serialized)
+    for invoke in [loaded, loaded.run]:
+        with pytest.raises(MlflowException, match="cannot execute in the tracking server"):
+            invoke(inputs="test")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("executor", [False, True])
+def test_client_and_executor_reconstruct_custom_scorer(monkeypatch, executor):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS", "true")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(scorer_execution, "_executor_pid", None)
+    if executor:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("_MLFLOW_SERVER_ARTIFACT_ROOT", "mlflow-artifacts:/")
+        scorer_execution.mark_scorer_executor_process()
+    else:
+        monkeypatch.delenv("_MLFLOW_SERVER_ARTIFACT_ROOT", raising=False)
+    serialized = SerializedScorer(
+        name="custom",
+        call_source="return inputs == 'test'",
+        call_signature="(inputs)",
+        original_func_name="custom",
+    )
+    loaded = Scorer.model_validate(serialized)
+    assert loaded(inputs="test") is True
+    assert loaded.model_dump() == asdict(serialized)
+
+
+def test_server_reconstructs_builtin_and_judge(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("_MLFLOW_SERVER_ARTIFACT_ROOT", "mlflow-artifacts:/")
+    for scorer in [Safety(), make_judge(name="judge", instructions="Check {{ outputs }}")]:
+        assert type(Scorer.model_validate(scorer.model_dump())) is type(scorer)
+
+
+def test_server_loads_ensemble_without_executing_custom_code(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("_MLFLOW_SERVER_ARTIFACT_ROOT", "mlflow-artifacts:/")
+    serialized = SerializedScorer(
+        name="ensemble",
+        ensemble_scorer_data={
+            "ensemble_fn": "agg_all",
+            "scorers": [
+                asdict(SerializedScorer(
+                    name="custom",
+                    call_source="return True",
+                    call_signature="(inputs=1 / 0)",
+                    original_func_name="custom",
+                )),
+            ],
+        },
+    )
+    loaded = Scorer.model_validate(serialized)
+    assert loaded.model_dump() == asdict(serialized)
+    with pytest.raises(MlflowException, match="cannot execute in the tracking server"):
+        loaded._scorers[0](inputs="test")
